name: PythonSafetyChecker
description: Run the Python safety checker (bandit security issues, ruff style/lint issues, AST mutable default arg checks) against Python files. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

prompt.mandatory_instruction: Run PythonSafetyChecker on Python files in the workspace to validate for security issues, lint errors, and unsafe patterns.
prompt.available_hint: Validates Python files for security (bandit), lint (ruff), and unsafe patterns (eval, hardcoded credentials)
